title: Control Plane Workflow Evidence
assertions: workflows with executable checks must either publish evidence artifacts or be registered as accepted gaps
artifact uploads must fail closed with if-no-files-found:error
accepted gaps are debt, not completion
live deployment and smoke workflows must publish only redacted summary evidence
new executable workflows without evidence cannot appear silently

loop.observation: Several workflows execute tests or live checks while leaving no durable JSON evidence artifact.
loop.hypothesis: A workflow evidence manifest can make CI observability debt explicit without blocking current legacy workflows.
loop.execute: Scan GitHub Actions workflows, classify evidence coverage, require any executable workflow gap to be registered, and require artifact upload steps to fail closed.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on unregistered executable workflows, non-strict artifact uploads, stale generated docs, or unused accepted-gap entries.
loop.retrospective: The repository can now distinguish evidence-covered workflows from accepted debt, keep artifact evidence fail-closed, and reduce the gap slice by slice.
